???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "Which agreement between caller and callee says where arguments are placed and where the return value is found?"

        The calling convention.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 7. Functions and control flow](../compiler/guide/stage-7-functions-and-control-flow.md).

    ??? question "What are the small, very fast storage slots inside the processor called?"

        Registers. Instructions mostly work on values held in them.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 6. The first machine code](../compiler/guide/stage-6-first-machine-code.md).

    ??? question "In a function call, what is the function being called named?"

        The callee. It hands its return value back to the caller.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 7. Functions and control flow](../compiler/guide/stage-7-functions-and-control-flow.md).
